source.whyItFits: The 2017 EULAR ultrasound-procedure paper was not available as full text. These two open papers cover the missing pieces: the OMERACT/EULAR ultrasound definitions of effusion, synovial hypertrophy, and Doppler signal, and the practical conduct of an ultrasound-guided musculoskeletal injection.
